label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches X and the wallet is never read.

label: User-context grant secret
help: Wallet reference holding the OAuth 2.0 user grant (access_token, refresh_token, client_id). Needed for post and delete_post; never the token itself.

label: App-only bearer secret
help: Optional wallet reference holding the app's bearer token. When set, searches and lookups use it instead of the user grant.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation; plain text is its main parameter. post and delete_post need Allow writes.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array among ["post", "delete_post", "search_recent", "get_user", "user_posts"]. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Posts per page
help: max_results sent to X for searches and timelines, 10-100. Each post read counts against the access level's quota.

label: Allow posting
help: Off by default. Required for post and delete_post; nothing is published while it is off.

label: Post length limit
help: Weighted length checked before sending: 280 for most accounts, more for subscriptions that allow long posts. X makes the final check.

label: Images directory
help: Only JPEG, PNG or WEBP files inside this directory can be attached. Empty disables images.

label: Allow delete_post
help: Separate switch for deleting posts by ID. X keeps no trash: a deletion is final.

label: Pages per read (max)
help: Pages per search or timeline; when reached, the result gives next_token to continue.

label: Image size limit (bytes)
help: Larger images are refused before the wallet is read. X accepts images up to 5 MB.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one operation, token refresh, image upload, pages and retries included.

label: Retries
help: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429 or a connection that never opened.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After or rate-limit reset further away returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to X.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger X responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: X API origin
help: Keep https://api.x.com. Another origin receives the tokens; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
